game_title: Stack Of Plates – Spirit Hall Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Eldritch Ruins – Spirit Hall, a hall of wandering spirits: the scholar mage must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Spirit Hall: a hall of wandering spirits
core_gameplay_loop: In Spirit Hall, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the scholar mage ahead. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ancient lock by solving code steps involving stack_balance that move the scholar mage forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ancient lock first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stack Of Plates' (Week 7 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Spirit Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crypt crawlers in Spirit Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
